roles.name: feature/refactoring
roles.explanation: Builds new features, or reorganizes code without changing what it does.

roles.name: bug-fix
roles.explanation: Reproduces a reported problem, finds the cause and fixes it.

roles.name: hillclimb
roles.explanation: Keeps improving one number toward a target, trying one idea at a time and keeping only what helps.

roles.name: judgment and prose
roles.explanation: Writing, and judgment calls about what the work should say.

roles.name: hardest tasks
roles.explanation: The trickiest code changes, where getting it wrong costs the most.

roles.name: how explorer
roles.explanation: Reads the code to find how something works.

roles.name: how explainer
roles.explanation: Turns that reading into a plain explanation.

roles.name: why investigators
roles.explanation: Digs through history for why something was built this way.

roles.name: why synthesizer
roles.explanation: Pulls those findings into one answer with sources.

roles.name: reflect tooling
roles.explanation: Reviews a finished session for lessons about tools.

roles.name: reflect judgment
roles.explanation: Reviews the session for lessons about decisions.

roles.name: arena runners
roles.explanation: Several models attempt the same task side by side.

roles.name: arena cross-judge pool
roles.explanation: Models that may judge those attempts.

roles.name: architect runners
roles.explanation: Several models sketch the design before code.

roles.name: interrogate reviewers
roles.explanation: Models that try to break the change.

roles.name: swarm workers
roles.explanation: Parallel helpers for many small jobs and for checking work.
